<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-screen-repair">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SmartphoneScreenRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Repair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPhoneDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAvailableItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcquisitionSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyRemainingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NoAcquisitionNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairPhone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendVideo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RepairSucceeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SentToExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OnlineTool" name="Online tool">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideListsAndChoices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideRepairInstructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin repair">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Enter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPhoneDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Enter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enter_Lists</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideListsAndChoices" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enter_Lists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Lists_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAvailableItems" name="Check which items are already available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Lists_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_AcquisitionSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcquisitionSplit" name="Choose how to obtain remaining items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_AcquisitionSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Acquisition_Friends</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Acquisition_Buy</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Acquisition_None</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Acquisition_Friends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Friends_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy remaining items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Acquisition_Buy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Buy_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NoAcquisitionNeeded" name="Continue with items already available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Acquisition_None</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_None_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcquisitionJoin" name="Continue after item acquisition">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Friends_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Buy_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_None_AcquisitionJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AcquisitionJoin_Instructions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AcquisitionJoin_Instructions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Instructions_Repair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone using the instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Instructions_Repair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Success</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Failure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Send review and/or video">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Success</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Video</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_Video</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Video_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Video_FeedbackJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackJoin_SuccessEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairSucceeded" name="Repair worked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackJoin_SuccessEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Failure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Expert_FailureEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Expert_FailureEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Enter" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_EnterPhoneDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Lists" sourceRef="Task_EnterPhoneDetails" targetRef="Task_ProvideListsAndChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Check" sourceRef="Task_ProvideListsAndChoices" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_AcquisitionSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acquisition_Friends" name="Friend option available" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquisitionSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">friendOptionAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acquisition_Buy" name="Items remain to buy" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquisitionSplit" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">itemsRemainToBuy</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acquisition_None" name="No further items needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquisitionSplit" targetRef="Task_NoAcquisitionNeeded">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noItemsRemainToAcquire</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friends_AcquisitionJoin" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_AcquisitionJoin" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_None_AcquisitionJoin" sourceRef="Task_NoAcquisitionNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_AcquisitionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcquisitionJoin_Instructions" sourceRef="Gateway_AcquisitionJoin" targetRef="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ProvideRepairInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Success" name="Repair worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairWorked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Failure" name="Repair did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not repairWorked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Review" name="Send review" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendReview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Video" name="Send video" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendVideo</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_FeedbackJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Video_FeedbackJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackJoin_SuccessEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairSucceeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_FailureEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
